title: Autonomous discovery of the Rh keto-VCP mechanism
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate and discriminate multiple mechanism hypotheses without an author-route hint.
The open stationary-point search requires coverage, deduplication, validation, and a defensible stopping decision.
